name: 1181-hand-over
about: ly-choose's first answer starts the game again: the old process hands over its files (logs handing over, then ending) and the new one waits for that, not for the old one's end: host.handover_ms within 2000 ms, no fallback wait

expect.log: host: handing over to a new process
host: ending: the new process takes over
host: started again: the process before it handed over its files after [0-9]+ ms

expect.no_log: host: started again: (no hand-over|the hand-over did not come|the process before it ended without)
